name: RUEG German subcorpora via DAKODA
attribution: RUEG / Research Unit Emerging Grammars in Language-Contact Situations; DAKODA reprocessed version
redistribution_policy: DAKODA marks the selected RUEG German subcorpora as open under CC0 1.0. RhymeLab stores source provenance and keeps downloaded archives local/gitignored.
corpus_version: DAKODA version handed over by Martin Klotz on 2023-02-08

ingestion_policy.purpose: Detailed local register evidence and browseable diplomatic/normalized utterance pairs.
ingestion_policy.matching: Exact normalized lexical-token sequence against existing modern-eligible RhymeLab phrases, independently on dipl and norm layers.
notes: dipl preserves participant/transcriber-near surface forms and is required for colloquial/reduction evidence.
norm is retained in parallel as the standard-form/search bridge; it must not overwrite dipl.
Per-document metadata such as formality, mode and speaker-age-group are preserved when available.
RUEG is a register sensor, not a population-representative German frequency corpus.
